title: Audience Track Enum
description: Canonical audience-track values for governed research, review, correction, withdrawal, and notice planning. Unknown audience context must remain unknown and must not default to internal_research or any other track.

x-governance.unknown_handling_rule: When audience context cannot be established, use unknown. Do not infer, substitute, or silently default to internal_research, internal_approved, restricted_audience, public_release, or irreversibly_disseminated.

non_authorization.statement: This enum classifies declared audience context for internal governance handling only. It does not identify, verify, contact, represent, profile, or determine eligibility for any audience or person.

privacy.minimum_disclosure_rule: Record only the declared governance track. Do not include identities, recipient lists, health data, biometric data, neural data, telemetry, credentials, or operational-system details.
